title: F29 · shutter_down · The Last Day
lines: n
Forty-three years. And today is the last one.
n
The new store won. That is all. Nobody did anything wrong.
n
He wraps his father's photograph in newspaper.
n
What am I, he asks nobody, without this shop?
"What am I," he asks nobody, "without this shop?"
n
Kabir had come to help carry boxes. He was looking at the tools.
n
Papa. Half this street calls you when something breaks. They do not call the big store.
"Papa. Half this street calls you when something breaks. They do not call the big store."
n
He looked at the slips for a long time.
n
The shutter came down on the shop.
A month later, a van went up and down the same street: Rakesh Repairs.
A month later, a van went up and down the same street: "Rakesh Repairs."
n
What ends can become what you wear into the next thing. That is sadhana.
n
